name: ecommerce-multi-tender-payments-api
description: Presents the Multi-Tender Payments domain over HTTP. It renders the module's refusals as status codes and never accepts a total, a balance or a capacity from a caller.
features: Read a payment plan with its server-resolved payable total and outstanding balance
Page through the append-only tender ledger of a plan
Admit a tender plan as pure arithmetic, storing and moving nothing
Record a tender against a plan under a required idempotency key
Reverse a captured tender as a new ledger entry carrying its reason
Two-class idempotency rendered as 409 permanent and 423 transient with Retry-After
An unbound payable-total resolver rendered as 503, distinct from a 422 unknown total
An OpenAPI 3.1 fragment with stable operation ids, kept in parity with the router both ways
